items.statement: Total liabilities fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to Rs. 12.20 crores, a reduction of close to 75%.
items.quote: Our total liabilities in this period fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to 12.20 crores. So, reduction of close to 75%.

items.statement: Trade payables reduced from Rs. 30.21 crores to Rs. 3.77 crores.
items.quote: We reduced our trade payables from 30.21 crores to 3.77 crores.

items.statement: Inventory nearly doubled to Rs 18 crore due to 25-30% of output requiring manual re-processing at labour homes, creating dead stock.
items.quote: So because we have expanded our facility, so the production got increased and in cashew generally we have one big challenge that almost 30% of our inventory which required manual intervention.

items.statement: Borrowings jumped from Rs 5 crore to over Rs 10 crore to fund working capital needs driven by rising raw material prices and higher production volumes.
items.quote: So our borrowings also have jumped from nearly 5 crores last year to over 10 Cr now.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of INR 2,434 lakh at end of FY26 with virtually debt-free balance sheet
items.quote: We ended financial year 2026 with net worth of INR3,751 lakh, cash and bank balance of INR2,434 lakh, and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
